## Summary

Closes #11.

Adds `LIAISON_TRACKER.md` as a lightweight liaison roster and cross-WG intake tracker, then links it from the README.

The tracker includes:

- external groups and standards bodies named in the charter, including OpenTelemetry GenAI SIG, OWASP AOS, W3C Trace Context, Agent Trace, Monocle, AGNTCY, and protocol maintainers beyond MCP
- internal AAIF coordination rows for TC, MCP, Goose, Taxonomy/Landscape, Identity and Trust, Security and Privacy, Governance/Risk/Regulatory, Workflows, and Accuracy/Reliability
- explicit `TBD` owner/cadence fields where no public liaison assignment is visible
- inbound ask and outbound follow-up columns
- an initial intake queue from the public 2026-06-11 and 2026-06-25 meeting minutes
- review checklist to keep private contact details out and owner fields explicit

## Validation

- `git diff --check`
- ASCII check on `LIAISON_TRACKER.md`
- Checked issue #11 acceptance criteria against the added tracker and README link

## Notes

This intentionally does not assign private liaison roles. It marks unknown owners as `TBD` so chairs or nominated leads can fill them in publicly later.
